_about: What Word 16.106 for Mac read and wrote for crates/ooxml-oracle/word/probes/min_text_size_probe.py (the document in cases/min_text_size_cases.py): 'word-kinds', per paragraph key the story type, font size and style Word gives it (its built-in style's name where it is one); 'word-caption', the caption Word's own insert caption made (its style id and name); 'tools-opened', whether Word opened the document and saved it. Regenerate with python crates/ooxml-oracle/word/probes/min_text_size_probe.py.
